pairs.registryProposal: redo-semantics and gesture-coalescing both assume the step boundary is the edit. Under debounced autosave the history entry is committed when the save completes, not at the edit, so the stack lags the document by the debounce plus the IPC round-trip. That is the shared root of this context's three technique deviations. A short rule would name the fix: invalidate redo and close the open step on the edit, and have undo flush or cancel the pending save before it pops. Candidate home: gesture-coalescing's 'what closes an open step' list.
